items.title: Hackers infect Android car head units with proxy botnet malware
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>A supply-chain attack targeting Android-based car head units is using a legitimate device-update app to spread malware that enlists compromised devices in a proxy botnet or uses them for ad fraud. [...]</article>

items.title: Named Pipes Under Attack: Securing Windows Interprocess Communication
items.author: Sponsored by ThreatLocker
items.content: <article>Windows named pipes provide fast interprocess communication, but weak access controls can expose privileged services to untrusted processes. ThreatLocker explains how endpoint verification, command authorization, strict input validation, and narrowly scoped privileges can help secure named-pipe communication. [...]</article>

items.title: New SynkLoader malware pushed in Microsoft Teams phishing campaign
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>A previously unknown malware family dubbed SynkLoader is being distributed in Microsoft Teams phishing campaigns to steal credentials via a fake lock screen. [...]</article>

items.title: Hundreds of leaked AWS keys give full control over corporate accounts
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>More than 9,300 Amazon Web Services (AWS) access keys publicly exposed between August 2022 and August 2026 are still active and valid. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft blames Windows gaming issues on RGB lighting devices
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft says ongoing issues causing games to crash or fail to launch after installing the August 2026 Windows updates may be caused by peripherals with RGB lighting. [...]</article>

items.title: Is Online Privacy Possible? How Digital Identities Can Help
items.author: Sponsored by ANONYOME LABS
items.content: <article>Using the same email, phone number, payment method, and other identifiers makes it easier for data brokers and attackers to profile your activity. Anonyome Labs explains how separate digital personas can reduce correlation and limit the impact of breaches, spam, and identity theft. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft rolls out Classic Outlook theme for New Outlook users
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft has started rolling out a Classic Outlook theme for users of Outlook on the web and the New Outlook for Windows. [...]</article>

items.title: CISA orders feds to patch actively exploited TrueConf Server flaws
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) ordered U.S. federal agencies to prioritize patching two actively exploited vulnerabilities in the TrueConf Server self-hosted communications platform. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft patches max severity code execution, privilege escalation flaws
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft has patched a maximum-severity vulnerability in the Entra ID identity and access management (IAM) platform that has been exploited in attacks. [...]</article>

items.title: Hackers abuse FTP server banners to deliver new Windows malware
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Threat actors are abusing FTP banners to hide commands that deliver two previously undocumented remote access trojans named E4del and PINHOLE. [...]</article>

items.title: SickKids data breach exposes employee and job applicant info
items.author: Ax Sharma
items.content: <article>Toronto's Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids) says a cybersecurity incident exposed the personal information of some current and former employees and job applicants, stemming from a flaw in third-party software. Clinical systems and patient records were not affected. (264) [...]</article>

items.title: Hackers poison arrayref Rust crate to push infostealer malware
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Hackers compromised the maintainer account behind the widely used Rust crate arrayref to introduce malware that executed on developers' systems during compilation. [...]</article>

items.title: Critical Elementor Pro bug exposes WordPress sites to RCE attacks
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>A critical vulnerability in the Elementor Pro WordPress plugin could allow attackers to upload executable files for remote code execution on the server. [...]</article>

items.title: How MSPs can catch phishing attacks email filters miss
items.author: Sponsored by Kaseya
items.content: <article>AI is making phishing attacks more personalized, convincing, and difficult for traditional email filters to detect. Kaseya explains how MSPs can monitor identity, email, and endpoint activity to detect and contain attacks that make it past the inbox. [...]</article>

items.title: Citrix urges admins to patch new NetScaler flaws as soon as possible
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Citrix has warned customers to immediately secure their systems against two vulnerabilities affecting NetScaler Gateway secure remote access solutions and NetScaler ADC networking appliances. [...]</article>
